# apple_subscription_offer_code_one_time_use_code (Resource)

Manages a batch of one-time-use codes for an `apple_subscription_offer_code`: Apple generates `number_of_codes` distinct codes, each redeemable once, for a campaign to hand out one per person.

**The codes themselves are not attributes of this resource.** They are secrets — anyone holding one gets the offer — and a batch runs to thousands, so they would sit in this resource's state in plain text for every configuration that creates one, whether it distributes them or not. Read them through the `apple_subscription_offer_code_one_time_use_code_values` data source, in the configuration that actually hands them out, or download them from App Store Connect. Apple says codes can take up to an hour to become redeemable.

Every attribute except `active` is fixed at creation, so a change generates a **new** batch and deactivates this one, invalidating every code already handed out.

~> **Nothing here can be deleted.** App Store Connect API 4.5.1 publishes no `DELETE` for an offer code, a custom code or a batch of one-time-use codes. `terraform destroy` **deactivates** the record (`active = false`), warns, and drops it from state; the record and its codes stay in App Store Connect forever. App Store Connect's help says a deactivated offer "can't be reactivated later" and that every code under it is invalidated, so deactivating — by destroy, by a replacement, or by setting `active = false` — is final for the codes customers already hold.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Apple refuses an expiration date more than six months out, and a date in the
# past makes codes that expire at once, so the date is the caller's to supply.
variable "codes_expire_on" {
  type        = string
  description = "When the codes expire, YYYY-MM-DD, at most six months from today."
}

resource "apple_subscription_offer_code" "schools" {
  subscription_id        = "6740021496"
  name                   = "Schools 2026"
  customer_eligibilities = ["NEW"]
  offer_eligibility      = "STACK_WITH_INTRO_OFFERS"
  duration               = "ONE_MONTH"
  offer_mode             = "FREE_TRIAL"
  number_of_periods      = 1
  prices                 = [{ territory_id = "AUS" }]
}

# Apple generates 2,000 codes, each redeemable once. A production batch holds
# 500 to 25,000; for more, add another batch for the same offer.
#
# The codes are not attributes here -- they are secrets. Read them with
# apple_subscription_offer_code_one_time_use_code_values where they are
# distributed, or download them from App Store Connect.
resource "apple_subscription_offer_code_one_time_use_code" "term_1" {
  offer_code_id   = apple_subscription_offer_code.schools.id
  number_of_codes = 2000
  expiration_date = var.codes_expire_on
}

# Codes for testing redemption with sandbox accounts: 10 to 10,000.
resource "apple_subscription_offer_code_one_time_use_code" "qa" {
  offer_code_id   = apple_subscription_offer_code.schools.id
  number_of_codes = 10
  environment     = "SANDBOX"
  expiration_date = var.codes_expire_on
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `expiration_date` (String) The last day the codes redeem, as a plain date in `YYYY-MM-DD` form — at most six months after the batch is created; codes expire at 12:00 a.m. Pacific Time on that date. Required. Cannot be changed after creation.
- `number_of_codes` (Number) How many codes to generate: 500 to 25000 for `PRODUCTION`, 10 to 10000 for `SANDBOX`. For more, create several batches for the same offer. Cannot be changed after creation.
- `offer_code_id` (String) The ID of the `apple_subscription_offer_code` the codes redeem. Cannot be changed after creation.

### Optional

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the codes redeem. Defaults to `true`. Setting it to `false` expires every unredeemed code in the batch at once, in place — customers who already redeemed one keep it — and is **final**: setting it back to `true` plans a new batch.
- `environment` (String) Where the codes redeem: `PRODUCTION` (the App Store, the default) or `SANDBOX` (test accounts only). Cannot be changed after creation.

### Read-Only

- `created_date` (String) When Apple created the batch.
- `id` (String) The unique Apple-generated identifier for the batch.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# The import ID is Apple's batch ID; the offer it redeems is read back with it.
terraform import apple_subscription_offer_code_one_time_use_code.term_1 9912345601
```
